# Idea Card

<!--
Prototype Factory — required card template.
One GitHub issue = one idea card. This repo holds ZERO implementation code.
Build only after promotion/launch, in a separate repo.
A card cannot leave raw until all fields below are filled.
-->

## One-liner
<!-- One sentence: what it is, for whom -->

## Type
- [ ] PRODUCT — needs market validation (research gate before spec)
- [ ] TOOL — personal/internal use (skips market research)
- [ ] OPS — routine operation; must leave this repo within 7 days (route to ops kanban)

## Problem / who hurts
<!-- Who has the pain, how often, what it costs them -->

## Why-you
<!-- Unfair advantage: context, assets, skills, distribution this specifically exploits -->

## Current alternative
<!-- What the user does today, including "nothing" -->

## Riskiest assumption
<!-- The one belief that, if false, kills the idea -->

## 24h-done definition
<!-- What exists 24h after build starts: live demo URL, user feedback artifact, etc. -->

## Kill criterion
<!-- Falsifiable stop rule. E.g. "no cafe owner agrees to trial within 5 asks" -->

## Token / time budget
<!-- Cap for research+build, e.g. 200k tokens / 6h agent time -->

## Evidence log
<!-- Append-only: date, what was learned, source link -->

| Date | Evidence | Source |
|------|----------|--------|
